svg.title: Parseff: direct-style parser combinators for OCaml 5
svg.desc: A launch film for Parseff. The wordmark springs in; Angstrom's monadic binds are wiped into plain let-in code; a cursor parses an IP address while the octet parser's lines light up, and 256 fails with a typed error; a broken statement list first stops at one error, then with diagnostics parses through with holes and two reported errors; two chunks split mid-token feed a push parser; JSON benchmark bars grow; six feature tiles cascade in; the end card shows opam install parseff.

g.text: Custom errors are OCaml variants you match on.
Recover from errors and keep parsing.
let x = 1; let y = ; let z = 3; let = 4;
1 | let x = 1; let y = ; let z = 3; let = 4;
1 | let x = 1; let y = ; let z = 3; let = 4;
Chunks can split a token. The parser is unchanged.
